what: FEMSA is a Mexican company built around two things: OXXO, the largest convenience store chain in Latin America with over 24,000 stores, and Coca-Cola FEMSA, the biggest Coca-Cola bottler in the world by volume.
customers: Mexican and Latin American shoppers buying daily essentials at OXXO, and retailers and consumers buying Coca-Cola products.
money: convenience stores in Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Peru and Brazil
moat: OXXO store density in Mexico, where it is often the only shop within walking distance, and exclusive Coca-Cola bottling territories.
risks: Net margin of about 2% reflects thin retail and bottling margins
Mexican consumer spending is sensitive to remittances and employment
Sugar taxes and regulation affect the drinks business
opportunities: OXXO is still opening stores at a steady pace across Latin America
The Spin payments app turns store traffic into financial services customers
watch: OXXO same-store sales and new store openings.
